tables.name: Authority
tables.description: Who officially governs the settlement: formal governance only, not hidden power, informal influence or factions.

results.name: Local Council
results.description: A small governing body formally handles settlement affairs.

results.name: Noble / Landed Ruler
results.description: A hereditary, landed or aristocratic figure formally governs the settlement.

results.name: Appointed Official
results.description: An official placed in authority by a higher government or ruling institution.

results.name: Merchant / Guild Rule
results.description: A merchant body, trade organisation or guild formally governs the settlement.

results.name: Religious Authority
results.description: A religious institution or recognised religious leader formally governs.

results.name: Military Authority
results.description: A military commander or military institution formally governs.

results.name: Elders / Community Leaders
results.description: Formal authority rests with respected or established members of the community.

results.name: Popular Assembly
results.description: Major settlement decisions are formally made collectively by a broad group of residents or recognised citizens.

tables.name: Representation
tables.description: Whether the authority has a single primary representative or a group. Only rolled when the Authority result does not already decide it.

tables.name: Authority Size
tables.description: The number of primary governing representatives, who will later receive Authority Figure NPCs. Not the size of the wider institution.

tags.name: Single Representative
tags.description: The authority has one primary representative.

tags.name: Group Representatives
tags.description: The authority has a group of primary representatives; Authority Size gives how many.
